quarterly_data.quarter: Bizlink press release: BizLink Completes Acquisition of Interplex Datacom, (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BizLink (TWSE: 3665) completed its acquisition of Interplex Datacom, previously a division of Ennovi (a Blackstone-managed portfolio company), in an all-cash transaction at an enterprise value of US$850 million plus up to US$50 million in contingent consideration. Interplex Datacom makes mechanical and structural components that form the physical architecture of AI server racks, complementing BizLink's electrical and connectivity products; BizLink says the deal strengthens its 'one-stop-shop' integrated data center offering and its precision metal fabrication capabilities, and adds Interplex Datacom's manufacturing footprint and established customer relationships across Asia. No revenue contribution or customer names stated.
quarterly_data.figure: All-cash; enterprise value US$850 million plus up to US$50 million contingent consideration
